toolArgs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, physically convincing realistic game reference.
Create one COMPLETELY NEW image, NOT a partial edit or patch. The supplied screenshot is only a reference for the EXACT CAMERA, COMPOSITION, BACKGROUND LAYOUT and established old travelogue game aesthetic.
Primary request: show convincing visible rope-to-wicker-basket attachments for a traditional hot-air-balloon passenger basket. Same first-person basket camera looking steeply DOWN over Beijing's Forbidden City, same landscape aspect around16:10, no new viewpoint. The curved warm dark-brown basket rim crosses the bottom fifth of the image, a small old brass compass sits left of center on the rim, golden palace roofs at upper left, pale ceremonial stepped terraces at upper right and gray courtyard below. Keep this layout, scale and camera, improve the close basket materials and attachment logic; do not replace the view with sky or another city.
There are EXACTLY TWO visible thick natural hemp suspension ropes: one coming down the left side near x6% and one down the right side near x95%, same thickness as reference. Do not add a third rope, extra struts or balloon burners. Both standing rope parts descend from out of the top of the picture and TERMINATE in a clearly visible secure tied attachment to the reinforced rolled WICKER RIM. Each rope bends into a tight eye/loop that visibly goes around and beneath the rim or through its strong woven edge, with a readable compact rope knot and short end tucked back into the binding. Show load path and overlap: rope lies snugly on a shaped worn-brown LEATHER PROTECTIVE SLEEVE around the wicker at the attachment, leather hugs the top and inner/front edge, contact shadows and compressed fibers show actual contact. The loop visibly wraps behind/under the rail and rejoins its knot, instead of a floating coil wrapped only around its own vertical rope. Keep both entire critical knots/attachment contacts in frame; let the bindings extend inward toward image center rather than being cut by the side edges.
CRITICAL: neither rope may run straight down unsupported in front of the basket rim and vanish out of the bottom. Neither rope may stop in empty air above it. EVERY visible suspension line ends in a visible tied connection on the basket. Rope and basket form one connected assembly. Use believable rope count, rope diameter, knot scale, leather thickness and closely woven willow wicker; no smooth wooden plank rail, no metal shackles replacing the requested rope binding. Make the rim visibly woven and reinforced.
Rendering: high-quality tangible hemp twist, woven willow and creased leather, weathered old-travelogue warmth, restrained natural palette, same neutral natural daylight and shadow direction as the game reference. Realistic coherent surfaces and detailed attachments, no cartoon, no watercolor wash, no sterile product studio. Background remains identifiable and in the same geometry, secondary to the rigging, without an extreme blur. Keep the small physical compass but avoid readable lettering; omit the on-screen pause button and ALL game HUD, captions and logos. No inset, diagram, arrows, labels, collage or added vignette. One whole fresh coherent scene.
